english_lines: Through women, the world is raised high;
That is how the earth itself lives—
Of giving heroes to the nation. (பெண்)
The ascetic sage who lives in the forest,
The poet who composes epics—the scholar
Who lives with passion for art—
Who gave them to the nation? (பெண்)
Resolute, thinking and daring for themselves,
They choose their lovers here—with joy,
They live a life of sacrifice—whatever
May come, their hearts do not change. (பெண்)
notes: The source's enjambed `கலை / ஆர்வத்தோடு` and `மகிழ் / வோடு` are represented without rewriting the Tamil lineation.

translator_notes: The source's argument about women, nation, love and sacrifice is kept direct and rhetorical.
Item-level lyric authorship remains unresolved at this booklet-evidence tier; translation does not upgrade attribution.
